SELECT t.* FROM ( SELECT 'RECEIPT' doc_type, r.id doc_id, r.receipt_no doc_no, r.biz_date, r.amount, 'AUDITED' status FROM fin_voucher v JOIN fin_receipt r ON v.source_type = 'RECEIPT' AND r.id = v.source_id WHERE v.id = #{voucherId} AND r.deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'PAYMENT', p.id, p.payment_no, p.biz_date, p.amount, 'AUDITED' FROM fin_voucher v JOIN fin_payment p ON v.source_type = 'PAYMENT' AND p.id = v.source_id WHERE v.id = #{voucherId} AND p.deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'PUR_INSTOCK', s.id, s.instock_no, s.instock_date, s.total_amount, CAST(s.status AS CHAR) FROM fin_voucher v JOIN pur_instock s ON v.source_type = 'PUR_INSTOCK' AND s.id = v.source_id WHERE v.id = #{voucherId} AND s.deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'SAL_OUTSTOCK', s.id, s.out_no, s.out_date, s.total_amount, CAST(s.status AS CHAR) FROM fin_voucher v JOIN sal_outstock s ON v.source_type = 'SAL_OUTSTOCK' AND s.id = v.source_id WHERE v.id = #{voucherId} AND s.deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'PUR_RETURN', r.id, r.return_no, r.return_date, -r.total_amount, CAST(r.status AS CHAR) FROM fin_voucher v JOIN pur_return r ON v.source_type = 'PUR_RET' AND r.id = v.source_id WHERE v.id = #{voucherId} AND r.deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'SAL_RETURN', r.id, r.return_no, r.return_date, -r.total_amount, CAST(r.status AS CHAR) FROM fin_voucher v JOIN sal_return r ON v.source_type = 'SAL_RET' AND r.id = v.source_id WHERE v.id = #{voucherId} AND r.deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'SALES_INVOICE', i.id, i.invoice_no, i.invoice_date, i.total_amount, CAST(i.status AS CHAR) FROM fin_voucher v JOIN inv_sales_invoice i ON v.source_type = 'INVOICE_SALES' AND i.id = v.source_id WHERE v.id = #{voucherId} AND i.deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'PURCHASE_INVOICE', i.id, i.invoice_no, i.invoice_date, i.total_amount, CAST(i.status AS CHAR) FROM fin_voucher v JOIN inv_purchase_invoice i ON v.source_type = 'INVOICE_PURCHASE' AND i.id = v.source_id WHERE v.id = #{voucherId} AND i.deleted = 0 ) t
